incidents.title: Compute cluster degradation — US-East zone
incidents.description: Multiple tenants reporting elevated latency and partial request failures on the US-East compute cluster. Cause: network fabric misconfiguration following maintenance window.

incidents.title: Metering agent OOM — metering-agent-01
incidents.description: Usage metering agent on pod metering-agent-01 hit memory limit and was OOM-killed. Billing events queued; no data loss. Pod restarted automatically.

incidents.title: Stripe sync worker timeout — non-critical
incidents.description: Stripe charge sync worker timed out on a large batch. Charges were not dropped; worker recovered on retry. Root cause: DB lock contention from concurrent migration job.
